about: The one OSV exception table (2.1-M204): each advisory OSV still reports that Canopi cannot fix itself, with its package, reason, a review date (until) and the upstream W row whose exit retires it. scripts/advisories.py generates osv-scanner.toml from it and fails an unlisted, expired or stale entry. Not a policy table: its rows live under advisories, never rules.

advisories.reason: Unsound VariantStrIter in glib 0.18, held by Tauri 2's GTK3 webview chain (wry, webkit2gtk); fixed in glib 0.20, which only the GTK4 chain uses.
Unmaintained; a build-time macro dependency of the gtk3-rs crates (glib-macros, gtk3-macros) in Tauri 2's GTK3 chain.
Unmaintained; zbus 5's D-Bus serialiser, pulled on Linux by tauri-plugin-opener and tauri-plugin-single-instance; retired with Tauri's Linux stack moving off it (the GTK4 move W17 tracks).
Unmaintained; zbus 5's name types, pulled on Linux by tauri-plugin-opener and tauri-plugin-single-instance; retired with Tauri's Linux stack moving off it (the GTK4 move W17 tracks).
Unmaintained; zbus 5's derive macros, pulled on Linux by tauri-plugin-opener and tauri-plugin-single-instance; retired with Tauri's Linux stack moving off it (the GTK4 move W17 tracks).
